translation: 团结；同心协力；【课件】团结一致
original_sentence: Supporters want to march tomorrow to show solidarity with their leaders.
definitionEn: unity or agreement of feeling and action, especially among individuals with a common interest.

posExamples.example: The whole team competed in the spirit of solidarity and fair play.
posExamples.translation: 整支队伍本着团结与公平竞争的精神参赛。

collocations.translation: 对某人表示声援／团结一致（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Supporters want to march tomorrow to show solidarity with their leaders.

collocations.translation: 本着团结的精神（课件短语）
collocations.example: The athletes marched into the stadium in the spirit of solidarity.

collocations.translation: 团结感；同心协力的意识
collocations.example: Team sports build a strong sense of solidarity among players.
Fans around the world expressed solidarity with the injured player.

synonyms.example: National unity is the foundation of a strong country.
synonyms.usage: unity 强调结合为一个整体的状态；solidarity 更强调因共同利益／目标而彼此支持。

advancedExpressions.expression: solidarity / unity / togetherness / cohesion
advancedExpressions.example: The motto called for solidarity, unity and togetherness among all nations.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The fans supported their team.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The fans marched to show solidarity with their team.

classPractice.question: Supporters want to march tomorrow to show ____ with their leaders. (团结)
classPractice.note: show solidarity with sb 对某人表示团结／声援，课件原句词块。

classPractice.question: The Olympic Games are held in the spirit of ____ and fair play. (团结)
classPractice.note: in the spirit of solidarity 本着团结的精神。

classPractice.question: 队员之间建立起了强烈的团结感。
classPractice.answer: A strong sense of solidarity was built up among the players.
classPractice.note: a sense of solidarity 团结感；build up 建立。

translation: 参加；参与；【课件】participate (fully/actively) in 积极参与
original_sentence: We encourage students to participate fully in the running of the college.
definitionEn: to take part in, become involved in or engage in an activity.

posExamples.example: Everyone in the class is expected to participate actively in these discussions.
posExamples.translation: 班级里的每个人都要积极参与这些讨论。

collocations.translation: （充分／积极地）参加某事（课件重点搭配）
collocations.example: Students are encouraged to participate fully in the running of the college.
The event could not go ahead without the participation of volunteers.
Over two hundred athletes participated in the marathon this year.

synonyms.example: Everyone was invited to take part in the sports meeting.
synonyms.usage: take part (in) 与 participate (in) 同义，都为不及物；take part 更口语，participate 更正式。

synonyms.example: Children should engage in more outdoor activities.
synonyms.usage: engage in 后接活动，engage 也可及物（engage sb）；participate 只作不及物，须接 in。

advancedExpressions.expression: participate in / take part in / be involved in / get engaged in
advancedExpressions.example: Every student is expected to participate actively in class activities.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people joined the marathon.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Many people participated actively in the marathon.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 participate actively in 替换 join，更正式且突出投入程度。

classPractice.question: The researchers examined various levels of noise on ____ (participate) as they completed tests of creative thinking. (2021 全国乙卷)
classPractice.note: 此处需名词作宾语，指受试者，participant 参与者，复数 participants。

classPractice.question: This treaty will require ____ (participate) countries to develop appropriate environmental labelling.
classPractice.note: 现在分词作定语修饰 countries，表示“参与的”。

classPractice.question: They expected him ____ (participate) in the ceremony.
classPractice.note: expect sb to do sth 期望某人做某事。

classPractice.question: We encourage students to participate fully ____ the running of the college.
classPractice.note: participate in sth 参与某事，介词 in 不可省。

translation: 参加比赛；竞争；【课件】compete in 参加……；compete with/against sb for sth 与某人为某事竞争
original_sentence: They competed in such events as boxing, running and the long jump.
definitionEn: to take part in a contest or game; to try to be more successful than others.

posExamples.example: Several companies are competing fiercely for business.
posExamples.translation: 几家公司为抢生意而激烈竞争。

collocations.translation: 参加诸如……的项目（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: They competed in such events as boxing, running and the long jump.

collocations.translation: 和某人为某事竞争（课件重点搭配）
collocations.example: He's hoping to compete against professional players for the title of world champion.
The stores compete to attract more customers.
Several companies are competing fiercely for business.

synonyms.example: Three teams are contending for the trophy.
synonyms.usage: contend for sth 与 compete for sth 同义，contend 更正式、书面。

advancedExpressions.expression: compete against/with sb ↔ competition (n.) ↔ competitor (n.) ↔ competitive (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: We need to work harder to remain competitive with other companies.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·such ... as 引导定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: such + n. + as ... 引导限制性定语从句，as 作关系代词，意为“像……那样的……”
advancedExpressions.example: They competed in such events as boxing, running and the long jump. (= such events as ...)

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The two teams played against each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The two teams competed against each other for the title.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 compete against ... for ... 替换 play against，突出争夺目标。

classPractice.question: The young man has often ____ (compete) against famous players, but so far he has always been beaten.
classPractice.note: 由 has often 可知用现在完成时，competed。

classPractice.question: They find themselves in ____ (compete) with people much more experienced than they are.
classPractice.note: in competition with 与……竞争，用名词。

classPractice.question: Over 200 ____ (compete) entered the race.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词作主语，指参赛者，用复数 competitors。

classPractice.question: It's getting very ____ (compete) in the car industry.
classPractice.note: 系动词 getting 后接形容词，competitive 竞争激烈的。

classPractice.question: 小孩子通常都会在母亲面前争夺关注。
classPractice.answer: Young children will always compete for their mother's attention.
classPractice.note: compete for sth 争夺某物。

translation: 种族的；人种的
original_sentence: Through sport, he fought against racial discrimination and won respect all over the world.
definitionEn: relating to or connected with the different races of people.

posExamples.example: The great athlete used his fame to promote racial equality.
posExamples.translation: 这位伟大的运动员利用自己的名气来推动种族平等。

collocations.example: Through sport, he fought against racial discrimination.
Sport can be a powerful force for racial equality.
The Games promote racial harmony among all participants.
Great athletes often break down racial boundaries.

synonyms.example: The city is home to many ethnic groups.
synonyms.usage: ethnic 侧重文化／民族背景，作前置定语（ethnic group）；racial 侧重人种，常搭 discrimination/equality。

advancedExpressions.expression: racial (adj.) ↔ race (n.) ↔ racism (n.) ↔ racially (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Racially motivated crimes must be firmly punished.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He fought unfair treatment based on race.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He fought against racial discrimination all his life.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 racial discrimination 替换啰嗦的 unfair treatment based on race。

classPractice.question: Great athletes often help to break down ____ boundaries between nations. (种族的)
classPractice.note: racial boundaries 种族界限，形容词修饰 boundaries。

classPractice.question: Sport has long been a force for ____ (race) equality.
classPractice.note: 名词前需形容词，race → racial 种族的。

classPractice.question: 通过体育，他与种族歧视作斗争，赢得了全世界的尊重。
classPractice.answer: Through sport, he fought against racial discrimination and won respect all over the world.
classPractice.note: fight against racial discrimination 与种族歧视作斗争。

translation: 多种多样的；形形色色的
original_sentence: Athletes from diverse cultures and backgrounds gather to compete in the same spirit.
definitionEn: very different from each other and of various kinds.

posExamples.example: The Olympics bring together athletes from a wide and diverse range of countries.
posExamples.translation: 奥运会把来自众多不同国家的运动员汇聚在一起。

collocations.example: Athletes from diverse cultures and backgrounds gather at the Games.
The event attracts a diverse range of participants.
Modern sports teams are increasingly culturally diverse.

synonyms.example: They competed in various events, from boxing to running.
synonyms.usage: various 只作前置定语，强调“数量多且不同”；diverse 可作定语／表语，更强调“彼此差异大、多元”。

synonyms.example: The programme offers a varied selection of sports.
synonyms.usage: varied 侧重“富于变化”；diverse 侧重“来源／种类多元”。

advancedExpressions.expression: diverse (adj.) ↔ diversity (n.) ↔ diversify (v.); a diverse range of / a wide diversity of
advancedExpressions.example: The Games celebrate the diversity of cultures across the world.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The athletes came from many different countries.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The athletes came from diverse cultures and backgrounds.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 diverse cultures and backgrounds 替换 many different countries，更凝练地道。

classPractice.question: The Olympic Games unite athletes from ____ (diverse) cultures around the world.
classPractice.note: 名词 cultures 前需形容词 diverse 多样的。

classPractice.question: Cultural ____ (diverse) makes the international event colourful and vibrant.
classPractice.note: 此处作主语，需名词 diversity 多样性。

classPractice.question: 来自不同文化背景的运动员齐聚一堂，以同样的精神竞争。
classPractice.answer: Athletes from diverse cultures and backgrounds gather to compete in the same spirit.
classPractice.note: diverse cultures and backgrounds 不同的文化和背景。

translation: 共同的；联合的；adj.&n. 关节；n. 接合处；连接点
original_sentence: Hosting the Games was a joint effort made by the whole nation.
definitionEn: involving two or more people or groups together; shared.

uncommonMeanings.example: After the long race, every joint in his body ached.
The pipe was leaking at the joint.

posExamples.example: The two schools organised a joint sports meeting.
posExamples.translation: 两所学校联合举办了一场运动会。

collocations.translation: 共同的努力（课件话题词块）
collocations.example: Hosting the Games was a joint effort made by the whole nation.
The stadium was built as a joint venture between two cities.
The nations took joint action to promote fair play in sport.
The two runners were declared joint champions.

synonyms.example: Their combined efforts made the event a success.
synonyms.usage: combined 强调“合并后”的整体（常作前置定语）；joint 强调“双方共同拥有／参与”。

synonyms.example: They have a shared goal of winning gold.
synonyms.usage: shared 强调“分享同一个”；joint 强调“合力共有”。

advancedExpressions.expression: a joint effort / joint action / joint venture / work jointly
advancedExpressions.example: The two countries made a joint bid to host the Olympics.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The whole nation worked together to host the Games.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Hosting the Games was a joint effort made by the whole nation.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a joint effort 名词短语替换 worked together，更书面凝练。

classPractice.question: Hosting the Olympic Games was a ____ effort made by the whole nation. (共同的)
classPractice.note: a joint effort 共同的努力。

classPractice.question: The stadium was built ____ (joint) by the two cities.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 built，用副词 jointly 共同地。

classPractice.question: 两所学校联合举办了一场运动会。
classPractice.answer: The two schools organised a joint sports meeting.
classPractice.note: a joint sports meeting 联合运动会。

translation: 激发；激励；【课件】motivate sb to do sth 激励某人做某事；是……的动机／原因
original_sentence: Motivated by the Olympic motto "Faster, Higher, Stronger", many well-known athletes have devoted themselves to achieving sporting excellence and pushing the boundaries of human achievement.
definitionEn: to make somebody want to do something, or to be the reason why somebody does something.

uncommonMeanings.example: He is motivated entirely by self-interest.

posExamples.example: She's very good at motivating her students.
posExamples.translation: 她非常擅长激励她的学生。

collocations.translation: 受……激励／驱使（课件原句词块，过去分词作原因状语）
collocations.example: Motivated by the Olympic motto, athletes push the boundaries of human achievement.

collocations.translation: 激励某人做某事（课件重点搭配）
collocations.example: The plan is designed to motivate employees to work more efficiently.

collocations.translation: 学习积极性很高的学生
collocations.example: Highly motivated students learn faster.
Most people said pay was their main motivation for working.

synonyms.example: The coach's words inspired the whole team.
synonyms.usage: inspire 侧重精神上的鼓舞、启发（inspire sb to do）；motivate 侧重给出行动的理由／动力。

synonyms.example: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions.
synonyms.usage: encourage sb to do 语气较温和；motivate 更强调提供内在驱动力。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·过去分词短语作原因状语
advancedExpressions.expression: Motivated by ... = Because they are/were motivated by ...，过去分词短语置于句首作原因状语，其逻辑主语即句子主语，与主语构成被动关系
advancedExpressions.example: Motivated by the Olympic motto, athletes devote themselves to sporting excellence. (= Because they are motivated by the Olympic motto ...)

advancedExpressions.expression: motivate (v.) ↔ motivation (n.) ↔ motivated (adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: The stronger the motivation, the more quickly a person learns.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Because the athletes wanted to reach the Olympic goal, they trained hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Motivated by the Olympic motto, the athletes trained hard.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用过去分词短语 Motivated by ... 替换原因状语从句，句子更凝练（课件语法点）。

classPractice.type: 用指定语法形式完成句子
classPractice.question: ____ (motivate) by the Olympic motto, many athletes have devoted themselves to sporting excellence.
classPractice.note: 逻辑主语 athletes 与 motivate 是被动关系，用过去分词 Motivated 作原因状语。

classPractice.type: 用 motivate 的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: You should first ____ the children and then teach them.
classPractice.note: 情态动词 should 后接动词原形。

classPractice.type: 用 motivate 的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: The stronger the ____, the more quickly the person will learn a foreign language.
classPractice.note: the 后接名词 motivation 动机。

classPractice.type: 用 motivate 的适当形式填空
classPractice.question: After every run, I feel fitter, happier and ____ to keep progressing.
classPractice.note: feel + adj.，motivated 有积极性的，与 fitter, happier 并列。

translation: 座右铭；格言；箴言
original_sentence: The Olympic motto "Faster, Higher, Stronger" motivates athletes to push the boundaries of human achievement.
definitionEn: a short sentence or phrase chosen as a guiding principle or ideal of behaviour.

posExamples.example: "Faster, Higher, Stronger" is the well-known motto of the Olympic Games.
posExamples.translation: “更快、更高、更强”是众所周知的奥运会格言。

wordForms.meaning: motto 的复数形式（两种拼写均可）

collocations.translation: 奥运会格言（课件话题词块）
collocations.example: The Olympic motto is "Faster, Higher, Stronger".
Our school motto is "Learning never stops".
"Never give up" is her personal motto.

synonyms.example: The team chanted their slogan before the match.
synonyms.usage: slogan 多用于广告／宣传，短小有煽动性；motto 是长期奉行的信条／格言。

synonyms.example: "Honesty is the best policy" is a well-known maxim.
synonyms.usage: maxim 更正式书面，指处世哲理；motto 更常用于机构／个人的行动准则。

advancedExpressions.expression: motto / slogan / maxim / saying
advancedExpressions.example: The Olympic motto captures the spirit of striving for excellence.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The words the Olympics uses are "Faster, Higher, Stronger".
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The Olympic motto is "Faster, Higher, Stronger".
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 motto 一词替换啰嗦的 the words ... uses，表达更精准。

classPractice.question: "Faster, Higher, Stronger" is the famous Olympic ____. (格言)
classPractice.note: the Olympic motto 奥运会格言。

classPractice.question: “永不放弃”是她的座右铭。
classPractice.note: sb's motto 某人的座右铭。

classPractice.question: Our school ____ (motto / slogan) is "Learning never stops". (校训)
classPractice.note: 校训用 motto；slogan 多指广告／宣传口号。

translation: 边界；界限；【课件】push the boundaries of ... 突破……的极限
original_sentence: Many well-known athletes have devoted themselves to achieving sporting excellence and pushing the boundaries of human achievement.
definitionEn: a real or imagined line that marks the limits or edges of something.

uncommonMeanings.example: Science keeps pushing back the boundaries of what is possible.

posExamples.example: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
posExamples.translation: 这条河形成了两国之间的边界。

collocations.translation: 突破／拓展……的极限（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: Athletes keep pushing the boundaries of human achievement.

collocations.phrase: the boundary between A and B
collocations.translation: A 与 B 之间的界限
collocations.example: The river marks the boundary between the two provinces.
Great sportspeople break boundaries between nations and cultures.
The passion for sport knows no boundaries.

synonyms.example: They live near the border between the two countries.
synonyms.usage: border 多指国家／地区的政治分界线；boundary 更泛，可指学科／活动的抽象界限，也指地界。

synonyms.example: She tested the limits of her endurance in the race.
synonyms.usage: limit 强调“最大程度／上限”；boundary 强调“分界线／范围边缘”。push the boundaries ≈ push the limits。

advancedExpressions.expression: push the boundaries of sth = go beyond the usual limits of sth 突破……的极限
advancedExpressions.example: Motivated by the motto, athletes push the boundaries of human achievement.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Athletes try to do better than anyone has done before.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Athletes keep pushing the boundaries of human achievement.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 push the boundaries of ... 替换直白的 do better than ...，更有文采（课件短语）。

classPractice.question: Many athletes have devoted themselves to pushing the ____ of human achievement. (极限)
classPractice.note: push the boundaries of sth 突破……的极限，常用复数。

classPractice.question: The river forms the ____ (bound) between the two countries.
classPractice.note: 此处需名词 boundary 边界。

classPractice.question: 对体育的热爱是没有界限的。
classPractice.answer: The passion for sport knows no boundaries.
classPractice.note: know no boundaries 没有界限。

translation: 展示，表露；【课件】证明，表明；示范，演示；vi. 游行示威
original_sentence: He came to public attention during the 1960 Rome Olympics, when he won the light heavyweight gold medal for the USA, demonstrating great talent and personality in the process.
definitionEn: to show or make clear something, such as an ability or quality, especially by giving proof or evidence.

uncommonMeanings.example: The theories were demonstrated to be false.
Her job involves demonstrating new software to users.
Students were demonstrating against the war.

posExamples.example: The team demonstrated breathtaking skills.
posExamples.translation: 这支队伍展现了惊人的技术。

wordForms.meaning: 表现；证实；示范；游行示威

collocations.translation: 展现极高的天赋和优秀的品格（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: He won the gold medal, demonstrating great talent and personality in the process.

collocations.phrase: demonstrate an ability to do sth
collocations.translation: 展现做某事的能力（课件搭配）
collocations.example: Employees should demonstrate an ability to communicate effectively.
Recent research demonstrates that exercise improves memory.
The athletes demonstrated their commitment to fair play.

synonyms.example: He showed great courage in the final round.
synonyms.usage: show 最普通；demonstrate 更正式，强调“用行动／证据清楚地表明”。

synonyms.example: The results prove that the method works.
synonyms.usage: prove 强调“确证为真”，可接 that 从句／宾补；demonstrate 侧重“通过表现或证据显示”。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·现在分词短语作伴随状语
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., demonstrating ...：现在分词短语作伴随状语，其逻辑主语为句子主语，与主语构成主动关系，表示同时发生的动作
advancedExpressions.example: He won the gold medal, demonstrating great talent in the process. (= and he demonstrated great talent)

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·when 引导非限制性定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: ..., when ...：when 引导非限制性定语从句，修饰表示时间的先行词（the 1960 Rome Olympics），相当于 and at that time
advancedExpressions.example: He came to public attention during the 1960 Rome Olympics, when he won the gold medal.

advancedExpressions.expression: demonstrate (v.) ↔ demonstration (n.)：hold/stage a demonstration 举行示威；a practical demonstration of sth 实际操作表演
advancedExpressions.example: In the cities vast crowds have been demonstrating for change.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He won the gold medal, and he showed great talent at the same time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He won the gold medal, demonstrating great talent in the process.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用现在分词短语 demonstrating ... 替换 and 并列句，表伴随，句子更紧凑（课件语法点）。

classPractice.question: 表明我们对保护环境的承诺
classPractice.answer: demonstrate our commitment to environmental protection
classPractice.note: demonstrate one's commitment to sth 表明对……的承诺。

classPractice.question: He built this wonderful device which he and I are going to demonstrate ____ you.
classPractice.note: demonstrate sth to sb 向某人演示某物。

classPractice.question: In the cities vast crowds have been ____ (demonstrate) for change.
classPractice.note: have been doing 现在完成进行时；此处 demonstrate 作不及物动词“游行示威”。

classPractice.question: After great efforts, he was able to give the public a brief ____ (demonstrate) of the connection between the two sets of figures.
classPractice.note: a brief ... 需名词，demonstration 演示。

translation: 继续进行；【课件】proceed to do sth 接着做某事；proceed with sth 继续某事；（向某方向）前进
original_sentence: Having said she wasn't hungry, she then proceeded to order a three-course meal.
definitionEn: to continue to do something; to go on to do the next thing.

uncommonMeanings.example: Passengers for Rome should proceed to Gate 32 for boarding.

posExamples.example: Work is proceeding slowly.
posExamples.translation: 工作进展缓慢。

wordForms.meaning: 一系列行动，事件；诉讼程序

collocations.translation: 接着做某事，继而做某事（课件重点搭配）
collocations.example: Having said she wasn't hungry, she then proceeded to order a three-course meal.

collocations.translation: 继续某事（课件重点搭配）
collocations.example: We're not sure whether we still want to proceed with the plan.
Passengers for Rome should proceed to Gate 32.
The development had proceeded steadily since the war.

synonyms.example: They continued with the training despite the rain.
synonyms.usage: continue to do / continue doing 均可；proceed to do 强调“做完前一件后接着做下一件”，proceed with sth 指“继续推进某事”。

synonyms.usage: advance 侧重向前移动／进展；proceed（正式）表示按计划有序地前进或继续。

advancedExpressions.expression: proceed to do / proceed with sth / proceed to a place; proceedings 一系列行动，诉讼程序
advancedExpressions.example: The proceedings of the enquiry will take place in private.

collocations.translation: 泪水顺着脸颊流下（课件 pour 例句同现）

She crossed the line with flushed cheeks and a huge smile.
Her teammate gave her a kiss on the cheek to celebrate.

synonyms.example: He had the nerve to demand a rematch after losing badly.
synonyms.usage: 指“厚颜”时 cheek（不可数）多用于英式口语，nerve 更通用

advancedExpressions.expression: turn the other cheek 逆来顺受；tongue in cheek 说反话/开玩笑地
advancedExpressions.example: He made the boast tongue in cheek, not really meaning it.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He cried a lot after winning.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Tears poured down his cheeks after winning.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 tears pour down one's cheeks 让“流泪”的画面更具体。

classPractice.question: By the end of the race, the sweat was pouring down her ____ (cheek).
classPractice.note: 两侧脸颊用复数，pour down one's cheeks 固定搭配。

classPractice.question: The cold wind made his ____ (cheeks / ankles) turn red.
classPractice.note: 脸颊被风吹红，符合语境。

classPractice.question: 站在领奖台上时，泪水顺着他的脸颊流下。
classPractice.answer: Tears poured down his cheeks as he stood on the podium.
classPractice.note: tears pour down one's cheeks。

translation: n. 半程马拉松（约21公里）
original_sentence: She finished her first half-marathon in under two hours despite the heat.
definitionEn: a running race that is half the distance of a marathon, about 21 kilometres.

posExamples.example: Thousands of amateurs signed up for the city half-marathon.
posExamples.translation: 成千上万的业余爱好者报名参加了城市半程马拉松。

collocations.example: He trained for months to complete his first half-marathon.
The half-marathon route wound along the river.
Many colleagues signed up for the charity half-marathon.

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 half- + marathon
advancedExpressions.expression: 前缀 half-（一半）+ marathon（马拉松）→ half-marathon 半程马拉松；类比 half-time 半场、half-price 半价
advancedExpressions.example: A half-marathon is roughly half the distance of a full marathon.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: She ran a 21-kilometre race.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She ran a half-marathon.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用专有名词 half-marathon 代替对距离的解释，更简洁。

classPractice.question: A ____ (half-marathon / marathon) is about 21 kilometres, half the full distance.
classPractice.note: half-marathon 是全马距离的一半。

classPractice.question: 尽管天气炎热，她还是在两小时内跑完了首个半程马拉松。
classPractice.answer: Despite the heat, she finished her first half-marathon in under two hours.
classPractice.note: half-marathon 作可数名词。

translation: n. 业余爱好者，非专业人员（adj. 业余的）
original_sentence: The race was open to both professionals and amateurs who loved running.
definitionEn: a person who takes part in a sport or activity for pleasure, not as a job.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 业余的；外行的（有时含技术不高之意）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was an amateur performance, full of small mistakes.
Compared with the pros, we looked like complete amateurs.

posExamples.example: Many amateurs train after work just for the love of the sport.
posExamples.translation: 许多业余爱好者下班后训练，只为热爱这项运动。

collocations.translation: 热心的/有天赋的业余爱好者
collocations.example: As a keen amateur, he entered every local race.
The event welcomed amateur athletes from all over the country.
After years as an amateur, she finally turned professional.

synonyms.example: The professional easily outran the amateurs.
synonyms.usage: professional 以此为职业、有报酬；amateur 出于爱好、无报酬，二者常对照出现

advancedExpressions.expression: amateur 业余的（出于爱好、无报酬）↔ professional 职业的（以此谋生、有报酬）
advancedExpressions.example: Whether amateur or professional, every runner respects the finish line.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The race let ordinary people who are not pros join.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The race was open to amateurs as well as professionals.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 amateur/professional 对照，表达更凝练、更书面。

classPractice.question: He is not a pro; he runs as an ____ (amateur / opponent) for the love of it.
classPractice.note: amateur 指出于爱好的业余爱好者。

classPractice.question: After years as an ____, she finally turned professional. (amateur / professional)
classPractice.note: 由业余转为职业，前空填 amateur。

classPractice.question: 这场比赛向职业选手和业余爱好者都开放。
classPractice.answer: The race was open to both professionals and amateurs.
classPractice.note: amateur 作名词。

translation: n. 踝，踝关节，脚踝
original_sentence: The runner twisted his ankle halfway through the race but refused to quit.
definitionEn: the joint connecting the foot to the leg.

posExamples.example: She wrapped a bandage around her swollen ankle after the match.
posExamples.translation: 比赛后她用绷带缠住了肿胀的脚踝。

collocations.example: He sprained his ankle on the muddy track.
Her swollen ankle kept her out of the finals.
The star player missed a month with an ankle injury.

advancedExpressions.expression: sprain one's ankle 扭伤脚踝；pull a muscle 拉伤肌肉；strain one's knee 拉伤膝盖
advancedExpressions.example: Despite spraining his ankle, he limped across the finish line.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He hurt his foot joint and could not run well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He twisted his ankle and could barely run.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 twist one's ankle 精确表达“扭伤脚踝”。

classPractice.question: He fell on the muddy track and ____ his ankle. (扭伤)
classPractice.note: twist/sprain one's ankle = 扭伤脚踝。

classPractice.question: Her ____ (ankle / cheek) was too swollen for her to compete in the finals.
classPractice.note: 脚踝肿胀影响比赛。

classPractice.question: 那名跑者在比赛中途扭伤了脚踝，但拒绝退出。
classPractice.answer: The runner twisted his ankle halfway through the race but refused to quit.
classPractice.note: twist one's ankle。

translation: adv. 逐渐地，逐步地
original_sentence: As the training went on, she gradually built up the strength to run longer distances.
definitionEn: slowly, over a period of time, in small stages.

posExamples.example: His confidence grew gradually with every race he finished.
posExamples.translation: 他每跑完一场比赛，信心就逐渐增长。

collocations.example: Her times gradually improved over the season.
Runners should gradually build up their mileage to avoid injury.
The weather changed gradually as the marathon went on.

synonyms.example: The team steadily climbed the league table.
synonyms.usage: steadily 强调“稳定不间断”；gradually 强调“分小步、慢慢地”，二者常可互换

synonyms.example: Little by little, she regained her fitness.
synonyms.usage: 口语化短语，作状语；书面更常用 gradually

advancedExpressions.expression: gradually / steadily / little by little / step by step / bit by bit
advancedExpressions.example: Step by step, she gradually reached the level of a professional.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Slowly she got stronger and stronger.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She gradually built up her strength week by week.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 gradually 搭配 build up，表达“循序渐进增强”，更书面。

classPractice.question: As the training went on, she ____ (gradual) got faster and stronger.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 got 需用副词 gradually。

classPractice.question: Runners should ____ (gradually / suddenly) increase their mileage to avoid injury.
classPractice.note: 循序渐进增加运动量，用 gradually。

classPractice.question: 随着训练的进行，他的信心逐渐增强。
classPractice.answer: As the training went on, his confidence gradually grew.
classPractice.note: gradually 作状语修饰动词。

translation: n. 一段时间（活动的），一节（课/训练）；（会议的）会期，开庭期
original_sentence: The coach scheduled an extra training session before the final relay.
definitionEn: a period of time spent doing a particular activity.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （议会等的）会期，届会；（法院的）开庭期
uncommonMeanings.example: Parliament is now in session to debate the sports budget.

posExamples.example: After a tough training session, the players cooled down together.
posExamples.translation: 一场艰苦的训练课后，队员们一起做了放松。

collocations.example: The team held a light training session the day before the match.
The committee is in session and cannot be disturbed.
The champion took part in a Q&A session with young fans.

synonyms.example: They rested for a short period between drills.
synonyms.usage: period 泛指一段时间；session 强调“用于某活动的一段/一节”，如 training session

advancedExpressions.expression: a training session 训练课；in session 在开会/开庭中；a photo session 拍照环节
advancedExpressions.example: The stadium is closed while the council is in session.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The coach added more time for training before the final.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The coach scheduled an extra training session before the final.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 a training session 表达“一节训练”，更专业简洁。

classPractice.question: The team held an intense training ____ (session / relay) before the final.
classPractice.note: training session = 一节训练课。

classPractice.question: Please be quiet; the committee is in ____ and cannot be interrupted.
classPractice.note: in session = 在开会/开庭中。

classPractice.question: 教练在决赛前安排了一节额外的训练课。
classPractice.answer: The coach scheduled an extra training session before the final.
classPractice.note: a training session。

translation: n. 界限，限度，限制【课件】；vt. 限制，限定【课件】
original_sentence: I ran my race relaxed and confident, even though my limits were being tested like never before.
definitionEn: the greatest amount of something that is possible or allowed; to keep something below or within a certain amount or scope.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 极限，能力/忍耐的最大程度（常用复数 limits）
uncommonMeanings.example: My limits were being tested like never before during the race.
You can go wherever you want within the town limits.

posExamples.example: There is no limit to how much fresh fruit you can eat in a day.
posExamples.translation: 你一天能吃多少新鲜水果是没有限制的。

posExamples.example: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.
posExamples.translation: 本次抽奖仅限英国居民参加。

collocations.example: I think we ought to put a strict limit on the amount of time we spend on the project.
The teaching of English should not be limited to words and grammar.
She has to work within the limits of a fairly tight budget.
There is no limit to how much fresh fruit you can eat in a day.

collocations.translation: 时间/速度/年龄限制【课件·拓展】
collocations.example: The speed limit on this road is 60 kilometres per hour.

collocations.translation: 超出/低于限度【课件·拓展】
collocations.example: The noise level was well above the legal limit.
Marathon runners push themselves to the limit in the final kilometres.

collocations.translation: 禁止入内的，不准接触的
collocations.example: This area is off limits to visitors during the games.

synonyms.example: There are strict restrictions on the use of the training ground.
synonyms.usage: n.；常用 restriction on sth，与 limit on sth 近义，restriction 更强调规则约束。

synonyms.example: The new rule restricts each team to three foreign players.
synonyms.usage: vt.；restrict sth to sth，与 limit sth to sth 同构，restrict 语气略正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: set a limit on / be limited to / within the limits of / there is no limit to
advancedExpressions.example: Success in sport has no limit, but training time is limited to the hours after school.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·系动词被动 be limited to
advancedExpressions.expression: be limited to sth 中 to 为介词，后接名词或动名词
advancedExpressions.example: Entry to this prize draw is limited to UK residents.

advancedExpressions.expression: limited(adj.有限的) / limitless(adj.无限的) / limitation(n.限制)
advancedExpressions.example: They may only have a limited amount of time to get their points across.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Don't spend too much time on this.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We ought to put a strict limit on the amount of time we spend on this.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 put a limit on 把口语化的 too much 升级为地道搭配。

classPractice.question: 在该城镇范围内，你可以去任何你想去的地方。You can go wherever you want ____ (在城镇范围内).
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】city/town limits 用复数表示区域边界。

classPractice.question: 我认为我们应该严格限制在这个项目上的时间投入。I think we ought to ____ the amount of time we spend on the project.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】put/set a limit on sth 对……设限。

classPractice.question: 教英语不应该仅仅局限于单词和语法。The teaching of English ____ words and grammar.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】be limited to 仅限于，to 后接名词。

classPractice.question: There is no limit ____ how much fresh fruit you can eat in a day.
classPractice.note: 【课件】there is no limit to sth，to 为介词。

translation: n. 马拉松赛跑；马拉松式的（耗时耗力的）活动
original_sentence: He's hoping to compete against full-time professional players for the title of world champion in the London marathon next year.
definitionEn: a running race of about 42 kilometres; anything that requires great effort or endurance over a long period.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 马拉松式的漫长活动（比喻用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: The final exam felt like a marathon of nine straight hours.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 马拉松式的，长时间的（作定语）
uncommonMeanings.example: The two leaders held a marathon meeting that lasted until midnight.

posExamples.example: She trained hard for months before running her first marathon.
posExamples.translation: 她苦练了几个月才跑完自己的第一场马拉松。

collocations.example: Thousands of amateurs run a marathon every spring in this city.
Just to finish a marathon is an achievement in itself.
He gets up at five every morning to train for the marathon.
As a marathon runner, she has to pace herself carefully.

collocations.translation: 北京/伦敦/波士顿马拉松（专有赛事，首字母大写）
collocations.example: He finished the London Marathon in just under three hours.

synonyms.example: The long-distance race was watched by thousands of spectators.
synonyms.usage: n.；泛指各类比赛，marathon 特指约42公里的长跑，范围更窄。

advancedExpressions.expression: Marathon（马拉松，希腊地名）→ marathon（长跑），源自公元前490年信使跑回雅典报捷的传说
advancedExpressions.example: The word marathon comes from the name of an ancient Greek battlefield.

advancedExpressions.expression: a marathon / an endurance test / a long haul（漫长艰苦的过程）
advancedExpressions.example: Writing a novel is a marathon, not a sprint.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The meeting was very long.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The meeting turned into a real marathon, dragging on for six hours.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 marathon 作名词的比喻义替换 very long，更生动。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：数千名业余选手每年春天在这座城市跑马拉松。
classPractice.answer: Thousands of amateurs run a marathon in this city every spring.
classPractice.note: run a marathon 跑马拉松，为固定搭配。

classPractice.question: He gets up at five every morning to train ____ the marathon.
classPractice.note: train for sth 为……训练。

classPractice.question: 用 marathon 或 sprint 填空：A 42-kilometre run is a ____, while a 100-metre dash is a sprint.
classPractice.note: marathon 指超长距离赛跑，与 sprint（短跑冲刺）相对。

translation: n. 主席，会长，董事长；（会议的）主持人
original_sentence: The chairman of the sports committee opened the meeting with a short speech.
definitionEn: a person in charge of a meeting, a committee, or an organization such as a company or a sports association.

uncommonMeanings.example: The company chairman announced record profits this year.

posExamples.example: As chairman of the Olympic committee, he opened the games officially.
posExamples.translation: 作为奥委会主席，他正式宣布运动会开幕。

collocations.example: He was elected the chairman of the students' union.

collocations.translation: 当选为主席（表职位名词前不加冠词）
collocations.example: She was elected chairman of the committee last week.
The vice-president acted as chairman while the boss was away.
The chairman of the board approved the new plan.

synonyms.example: The president of the club welcomed all the new members.
synonyms.usage: n.；president 多指协会/国家/公司最高负责人，chairman 侧重主持会议或董事会。

synonyms.example: The chairperson called the meeting to order.
synonyms.usage: n.；不带性别色彩，现代英语中越来越常用来替代 chairman。

advancedExpressions.expression: chair（椅子/主持）+ man = chairman；对应 chairwoman / chairperson
advancedExpressions.example: To avoid gender bias, many organizations now use chairperson instead of chairman.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·表职位名词作补语零冠词
advancedExpressions.expression: elect/appoint sb (as) chairman 中职位名词前常省略冠词
advancedExpressions.example: He was elected chairman of the association.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He led the meeting.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As chairman, he chaired the meeting and kept the discussion on track.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 chairman 及动词 chair 使表述更正式准确。

classPractice.question: He was elected ____ (chair) of the sports committee last month.
classPractice.note: elect sb chairman 当选为主席，此处需名词。

classPractice.question: She was elected ____ chairman of the committee, and the post carries no salary.
classPractice.note: 表职位的名词作宾补时前面不加冠词。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：作为俱乐部会长，他欢迎所有新成员。
classPractice.answer: As chairman of the club, he welcomed all the new members.
classPractice.note: the chairman of sth 表示某组织的会长/主席。

translation: n. 身体素质，体质【课件】；宪法，章程【课件】
original_sentence: We were told …, and while I didn't feel that I had a strong constitution to run that far, I thought the next best thing would be to help those who could.
definitionEn: the general physical condition and health of a person's body; the system of basic laws and principles by which a country or organization is governed.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 身体素质，体质（the condition of a person's body）
uncommonMeanings.example: You need a strong constitution to run a full marathon.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宪法，章程（the basic laws of a country/organization）
uncommonMeanings.example: Freedom of speech is protected under the constitution.

posExamples.example: I didn't feel that I had a strong constitution to run that far.
posExamples.translation: 我觉得自己没有那么好的体质能跑那么远。

wordForms.meaning: 宪法的，符合宪法的；体质上的

collocations.translation: 体质健康／强壮／虚弱【课件】
collocations.example: He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
According to the constitution, all citizens are equal before the law.
Long-distance runners usually have a robust constitution.
The country amended its constitution to protect the environment.

synonyms.example: He has the powerful physique of a weightlifter.
synonyms.usage: n.；physique 指身材外形与肌肉，constitution 侧重内在体质与健康状况。

advancedExpressions.type: 熟词僻义·constitution 两义对照
advancedExpressions.expression: constitution =①身体素质（have a strong constitution）②宪法（under the constitution）
advancedExpressions.example: Under the constitution he had every right to protest, though his weak constitution kept him at home.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·while 引导让步状语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: while I didn't feel that I had a strong constitution... 中 while 意为“虽然，尽管”
advancedExpressions.example: While I didn't feel that I had a strong constitution, I still joined the run.

advancedExpressions.expression: constitution(n.) / constitutional(adj.) / constitute(vt.构成)
advancedExpressions.example: These changes constitute a serious violation of the constitution.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He is very healthy and strong.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He has a strong constitution and can endure long hours of training.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 have a strong constitution 替换泛泛的 healthy and strong，更贴合体育语境。

classPractice.question: 选义项填空（体质/宪法）：You need a strong ____ to complete an ultra-marathon. 此处 constitution 意为____。
classPractice.note: 【课件】constitution 表体质，常与 strong/weak/healthy 搭配。

classPractice.question: According to the ____ (constitute), all citizens enjoy equal rights.
classPractice.note: 根据宪法，此处需名词 constitution。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：他体质强壮，很少生病。
classPractice.answer: He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.
classPractice.note: have a strong constitution 体质强壮，为课件核心搭配。

translation: vt. & vi. 倾倒，倒出【课件】；涌流，倾泻【课件】；（雨）倾盆而下【课件】
original_sentence: Cathy and I quickly poured water into the cups for them.
definitionEn: to make a liquid flow from a container in a steady stream; (of liquid or people) to flow or move rapidly and in large quantities.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 倾倒，倒出（cause a liquid to flow in a steady stream）
uncommonMeanings.example: I've poured a cup of tea for you.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 涌流，倾泻；（人群）涌入（flow rapidly in a steady stream）
uncommonMeanings.example: People have been pouring into stadiums since early morning.
The rain continued to pour down all afternoon.

posExamples.example: Pour the sauce over the pasta and serve at once.
posExamples.translation: 把酱汁浇在意大利面上，立刻端上桌。

posExamples.example: Tears poured down his cheeks when the anthem played.
posExamples.translation: 国歌响起时，泪水从他脸颊上淌下来。

wordForms.meaning: 倾盆的（pouring rain 倾盆大雨）

collocations.translation: 把……倒进……【课件·课文原句 poured water into the cups】
collocations.example: Pour the honey into the bowl and mix it thoroughly.

collocations.translation: （雨）倾盆而下；（汗/泪）往下流【课件】
collocations.example: The sweat was pouring down her face by the end of the race.

collocations.phrase: pour out sth / pour out one's heart to sb
collocations.translation: 毫无保留地倾诉；向某人敞开心扉【课件】
collocations.example: Friends are those to whom we can pour out our heart when we're sad.

collocations.translation: （人群）涌入；大量投入（资金等）【课件】
collocations.example: The government has poured millions into the education system.
Don't pour cold water on the young players' enthusiasm.

collocations.phrase: it never rains but it pours
collocations.example: First he lost his keys, then his phone—it never rains but it pours.

synonyms.example: The river flows quietly through the valley.
synonyms.usage: vi.；flow 强调平稳流动，pour 强调大量而急速地倾泻或倒出。

synonyms.example: Fans flooded into the stadium before kick-off.
synonyms.usage: vi.；flood into 与 pour into 近义，都指人群大量涌入。

advancedExpressions.expression: pour into / pour down / pour out (one's heart)
advancedExpressions.example: As rain poured down, thousands of fans poured into the stadium.

advancedExpressions.expression: pour down = course down / stream down；pour into = flood into / crowd into
advancedExpressions.example: Sweat streamed down his face while spectators flooded into the arena.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·介词+关系代词定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: those to whom we can pour out our heart 中 to whom 引导定语从句
advancedExpressions.example: Friends are those to whom we can pour out our heart.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Many people came into the stadium.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: People have been pouring into the stadium since dawn.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 pour into 替换 come into，突出人群大量涌入的动感。

classPractice.question: Pour the honey ____ the bowl and mix it thoroughly with the other ingredients.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】pour sth into sth 把……倒进……。

classPractice.question: Friends are those whom we can pour out our heart ____ when we're sad.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】pour out one's heart to sb，介词 to 后置。

classPractice.question: The sweat was pouring ____ her face by the end of the race.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】pour down （汗/泪）往下流。

classPractice.question: I was standing in the ____ (pour) rain for an hour waiting for my bus.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】pouring rain 倾盆大雨，现在分词作定语。

classPractice.question: When the movie ended, the crowd poured ____ the street.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】pour into 涌入。

translation: n. 名人，名流【课件】；[U] 名望，声誉【课件】
original_sentence: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator after retiring from professional football.
definitionEn: a famous person, especially in sport or entertainment; the state of being famous.

uncommonMeanings.example: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.

posExamples.example: Several sporting celebrities attended the charity match.
posExamples.translation: 几位体育名人出席了这场慈善比赛。

collocations.example: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.
The award was presented by a well-known sporting celebrity.
They held a party in celebration of their fiftieth wedding anniversary.
The musician is celebrated for her precise technique and emotional expressiveness.
The young swimmer rose to celebrity overnight after the games.

synonyms.example: She won worldwide fame as a marathon runner.
synonyms.usage: n.[U]；fame 只表抽象名望，celebrity 既可表名望，也可指“名人”本身（可数）。

synonyms.example: He became a football star while still a teenager.
synonyms.usage: n.；star 多用于娱乐/体育明星，celebrity 泛指各领域名人。

advancedExpressions.expression: celebrity(n.名人/名望) / celebrate(vt.庆祝) / celebration(n.庆典) / celebrated(adj.著名的)
advancedExpressions.example: The celebrated athlete's return was celebrated with a grand celebration.

advancedExpressions.expression: in celebration of / in memory of / in honour of / in praise of / in favour of / in defence of【课件】
advancedExpressions.example: A ceremony was held in honour of the celebrated coach.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He became famous as a commentator.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He achieved celebrity as a sports commentator.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 achieve celebrity 替换 become famous，更正式凝练。

classPractice.question: He achieved ____ (celebrate) as a sports commentator after retiring.
classPractice.note: achieve celebrity 获得名望，此处需名词。

classPractice.question: A party was held in ____ (celebrate) of their team's championship.
classPractice.note: in celebration of 为庆祝……，需名词。

classPractice.question: The musician is ____ (celebrate) for her precise technique.
classPractice.note: be celebrated for 以……著名，用过去分词作形容词。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：几位体育名人出席了这场慈善比赛。
classPractice.answer: Several sporting celebrities attended the charity match.
classPractice.note: celebrity 表“名人”时为可数名词，复数 celebrities。

translation: n. 对手，敌手【课件】；反对者【课件】
original_sentence: Whether you come first or last, it is important to remember that at any sporting event, you face two opponents.
definitionEn: a person who competes against you in a game or contest; a person who disagrees with or opposes an idea, action, or plan.

uncommonMeanings.example: Opponents of the plan argued that it would harm the environment.

posExamples.example: She beat her opponent in straight sets to win the title.
posExamples.translation: 她直落几盘击败对手，赢得冠军。

wordForms.meaning: 对立的；相竞争的（the opposing team）

collocations.translation: 面对对手【课件·课文原句】
collocations.example: At any sporting event, you face two opponents—the other player and yourself.
Opponents of the reform gathered outside the stadium.

collocations.translation: 值得尊敬的/强劲的对手
collocations.example: He praised his rival as a worthy opponent after the match.
She defeated her opponent with a last-minute goal.

collocations.translation: 对方球队【课件·词族 opposing】
collocations.example: Players try to kick the ball into the opposing team's goal.

synonyms.example: The two teams have been fierce rivals for years.
synonyms.usage: n.；rival 强调长期竞争关系，opponent 指某场比赛/辩论中当下的对手。

synonyms.example: Over 200 competitors entered the race.
synonyms.usage: n.；competitor 泛指参加比赛的人，opponent 强调与你直接对抗的一方。

advancedExpressions.expression: opponent(n.对手/反对者) / oppose(v.反对) / opposing(adj.对立的) / opposed(adj.反对的) / opposite(prep.对面)【课件】
advancedExpressions.example: Opponents of the plan strongly oppose it, and the opposing views split the committee.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·whether…or… 让步状语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: Whether you come first or last, ... “不管是……还是……”引导让步状语从句【课件】
advancedExpressions.example: Whether you win or lose, you should respect your opponent.

advancedExpressions.expression: oppose sth / be opposed to sth / as opposed to（相对于，而非）【课件】
advancedExpressions.example: Many locals are opposed to the plan, as opposed to supporting it.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The other player was very strong.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She proved to be a formidable opponent, testing me to my limits.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 formidable opponent 替换 very strong player，更具赛场语感。

classPractice.question: It doesn't matter whether you win or lose. → ____ you win ____ lose, you must respect your opponent.
classPractice.note: 【课件】whether…or… 引导让步状语从句，意为“不管……还是……”。

classPractice.question: ____ (oppose) of the plan argued that it would harm local businesses.
classPractice.note: opponents of sth ……的反对者，主语需用复数名词。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：赛后他称赞对手是一位值得尊敬的对手。
classPractice.answer: After the match he praised his rival as a worthy opponent.
classPractice.note: a worthy opponent 值得尊敬的对手。

translation: n. 谦逊，谦卑
original_sentence: A true champion accepts both victory and defeat with humility.
definitionEn: the quality of not thinking that you are better or more important than other people; modesty.

posExamples.example: Despite his fame, the athlete spoke with great humility about his coaches.
posExamples.translation: 尽管声名远扬，这位运动员谈起自己的教练时仍十分谦逊。

collocations.example: He accepted the award with humility, thanking his whole team.
A good sportsperson accepts defeat with humility and grace.
The champion showed remarkable humility in the interview.
Standing on the podium filled her with a deep sense of humility.
Losing that final taught him humility.

synonyms.example: She spoke about her success with genuine modesty.
synonyms.usage: n.；modesty 与 humility 近义，humility 更强调不自视高人一等的内在品格。

advancedExpressions.expression: humility(n.谦逊) / humble(adj.谦逊的) / humbly(adv.谦逊地)
advancedExpressions.example: A humble champion always behaves with humility.

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·体育精神品格
advancedExpressions.expression: humility 谦逊 / grace 风度 / dignity 尊严 / modesty 谦虚（describe true sportsmanship）
advancedExpressions.example: True sportsmanship means facing both wins and losses with humility, grace and dignity.

advancedExpressions.expression: humble(adj.)→ humility(n.)，形容词加 -ity/-ility 变抽象名词，类比 able→ability
advancedExpressions.example: The suffix -ity turns humble into the noun humility.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He was not proud even though he won.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Even in victory, he behaved with genuine humility.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 with humility 替换 not proud，正面表达谦逊品格，更凝练。

classPractice.question: Despite his fame, the athlete spoke with great ____ (humble) about his coaches.
classPractice.note: with 后接名词，humble 的名词形式为 humility。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：优秀的运动员会谦逊地接受失败。
classPractice.answer: A good sportsperson accepts defeat with humility.
classPractice.note: accept defeat with humility 谦逊地接受失败。

classPractice.question: 用 humility 或 humble 填空：He is a ____ man who wins with ____.
classPractice.note: 第一空作定语用形容词 humble，第二空 with 后用名词 humility。

translation: n. 优雅，优美；（举止的）风度，得体；宽限期
original_sentence: She lost the final, but accepted defeat with grace and dignity.
definitionEn: an attractive quality of movement that is smooth and elegant; polite and pleasant behaviour, especially in a difficult situation.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 得体的风度，大度（尤指困境中的得体表现）
uncommonMeanings.example: He accepted the referee's decision with good grace.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宽限期，延展期（extra time before a deadline）
uncommonMeanings.example: The bank gave them five days' grace to pay the fee.
A famous coach graced the opening ceremony with his presence.

posExamples.example: The gymnast moved across the mat with effortless grace.
posExamples.translation: 那位体操运动员轻松优雅地在垫子上移动。

wordForms.meaning: 亲切的，有礼貌的；宽厚的

collocations.example: The skater performed her routine with grace and confidence.

collocations.translation: 大度地/爽快地接受某事
collocations.example: She accepted the defeat with good grace and congratulated her rival.
The dancer moved with such grace that the crowd fell silent.
You are allowed a few days of grace to renew the membership.
A true champion handles defeat with grace and dignity.

synonyms.example: She skated with the elegance of a professional.
synonyms.usage: n.；elegance 侧重外在的雅致美感，grace 兼指动作优美与举止得体。

advancedExpressions.expression: grace =①优雅（move with grace）②得体大度（with good grace）③宽限期（days of grace）
advancedExpressions.example: She lost with good grace, moving off the court with quiet grace.

advancedExpressions.expression: grace(n.) / graceful(adj.优雅的) / gracefully(adv.) / gracious(adj.亲切宽厚的)
advancedExpressions.example: The graceful skater bowed graciously to the cheering crowd.

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·体育精神品格
advancedExpressions.expression: grace 风度 / humility 谦逊 / dignity 尊严 / sportsmanship 体育精神
advancedExpressions.example: He showed true sportsmanship, accepting the loss with grace and dignity.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: She accepted losing without complaining.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She accepted defeat with good grace.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 with good grace 替换 without complaining，突出得体大度的风度。

classPractice.question: The gymnast moved across the mat with effortless ____ (graceful).
classPractice.note: with 后接名词，graceful 的名词形式为 grace。

classPractice.question: 用 grace 或 graceful 填空：She is a ____ dancer who moves with ____.
classPractice.note: 第一空作定语用形容词 graceful，第二空 with 后用名词 grace。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：真正的冠军会以风度和尊严面对失败。
classPractice.answer: A true champion faces defeat with grace and dignity.
classPractice.note: with grace and dignity 以风度与尊严，为体育精神主题固定表达。

translation: n. 尊严，尊贵；庄重，端庄
original_sentence: Even in defeat, she carried herself with dignity and thanked her opponent.
definitionEn: the quality of being worthy of honour and respect; calm and serious behaviour that makes people respect you.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 庄重，端庄（calm and serious manner）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old coach spoke with quiet dignity about his long career.

posExamples.example: He faced the defeat with great dignity.
posExamples.translation: 他非常有尊严地面对这场失败。

collocations.example: She accepted the criticism with dignity and said nothing rude.
Sport should respect the human dignity of every athlete.
He managed to maintain his dignity despite the crushing loss.
He felt it was beneath his dignity to argue with the referee.
Winning fairly gave the whole team a real sense of dignity.

synonyms.example: She took pride in representing her country.
synonyms.usage: n.；pride 侧重内心自豪感，dignity 强调值得尊重的庄重与自尊，可为他人所感知。

advancedExpressions.expression: beneath one's dignity 有失身份/体面（beneath sb 表'有失身份'）
advancedExpressions.example: He thought it beneath his dignity to complain about the score.

advancedExpressions.expression: dignity(n.) / dignified(adj.庄重的) / dignify(vt.使有尊严)
advancedExpressions.example: The dignified old champion answered every question with dignity.

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·体育精神品格
advancedExpressions.expression: dignity 尊严 / grace 风度 / humility 谦逊 / respect 尊重
advancedExpressions.example: True sportsmanship is about treating your opponent with respect and dignity.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He stayed calm and proud after losing.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He faced the loss with quiet dignity.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 with dignity 替换 calm and proud，凝练地表达庄重自尊。

classPractice.question: He faced the defeat with great ____ (dignified) and thanked his rival.
classPractice.note: with 后接名词，dignified 的名词形式为 dignity。

classPractice.question: 他觉得和裁判争吵有失身份。He felt it was ____ ____ ____ to argue with the referee. (beneath)
classPractice.note: beneath one's dignity 有失身份/体面。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：体育应尊重每一位运动员的尊严。
classPractice.answer: Sport should respect the dignity of every athlete.
classPractice.note: respect one's dignity 尊重某人的尊严。

translation: n. 长橇，雪车（冰上高速滑行的竞速运动器材）
original_sentence: The first athlete to receive the award was an Italian bobsleigh competitor named Eugenio Monti.
definitionEn: a small vehicle with two sets of runners, used for racing down a specially built ice track at high speed; the winter sport of racing in such a vehicle.

uncommonMeanings.example: Bobsleigh is one of the most thrilling events at the Winter Olympics.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 乘雪车滑行，参加雪车比赛
uncommonMeanings.example: The team has been bobsleighing together for six years.

posExamples.example: The bobsleigh shot down the icy track at nearly 130 kilometres per hour.
posExamples.translation: 雪车以近每小时130公里的速度冲下冰道。

collocations.translation: 雪车运动员【课件·课文原句 Eugenio Monti】
collocations.example: The award went to an Italian bobsleigh competitor named Eugenio Monti.
He was chosen to drive for the national bobsleigh team.
The new bobsleigh track was built for the Winter Olympics.

collocations.phrase: win a medal in the bobsleigh
collocations.translation: 在雪车项目上获得奖牌
collocations.example: They won a bronze medal in the four-man bobsleigh.

synonyms.example: The children pulled a wooden sledge up the snowy slope.
synonyms.usage: n.；sledge 泛指各类雪橇，bobsleigh 特指冰道竞速用的双滑板雪车，速度极快。

advancedExpressions.expression: bob（上下颠簸/急动）+ sleigh（雪橇）= bobsleigh；美式拼写 bobsled
advancedExpressions.example: The word bobsleigh combines bob and sleigh to name this fast winter sport.

advancedExpressions.expression: the first athlete to receive the award 中 the first (…) to do sth “第一个做……的”，不定式作后置定语【课件】
advancedExpressions.example: The first athlete to receive the award was an Italian bobsleigh competitor.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Eugenio Monti was the first person who got the award.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Eugenio Monti was the first athlete to receive the award.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 the first ... to do 结构替换定语从句，更简洁地道（课件语法点）。

classPractice.type: 用指定语法形式完成句子
classPractice.question: In 1931, Addams became the first woman ____ (win) the Nobel Peace Prize.
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】the first (...) to do 结构，用不定式作后置定语。

classPractice.type: 用指定语法形式完成句子
classPractice.question: He was the first ____ (arrive) and the last ____ (leave).
classPractice.note: 【课件原题】the first/last to do sth 结构。

classPractice.question: 把中文译成英文：首位获奖的运动员是一名意大利雪车选手。
classPractice.answer: The first athlete to receive the award was an Italian bobsleigh competitor.
classPractice.note: a bobsleigh competitor 雪车运动员，the first ... to do 第一个做……的。

translation: 【课件】无私的；不自私的；慷慨的
original_sentence: An unselfish act on the field can mean far more to a team than a single goal.
definitionEn: willing to put other people's needs or wishes before your own; not selfish.

posExamples.example: Passing the ball instead of shooting was a truly unselfish decision.
posExamples.translation: 把球传出去而不是自己射门，是一个真正无私的决定。

collocations.example: Sharing his medal with teammates was an unselfish act.
Good players are unselfish with the ball.
Her unselfish devotion to the team inspired everyone.

synonyms.example: It was a selfless gesture that won everyone's respect.
synonyms.usage: 作定语或表语，语义与 unselfish 完全相同，课件并列列出

synonyms.example: He was generous in praising his rivals.
synonyms.usage: 作表语时常接 with sth / in doing sth

advancedExpressions.expression: un- + selfish = unselfish（不自私的）；对比 selfish → selfless（无私的）
advancedExpressions.example: Selfish players think of glory; unselfish players think of the team.

advancedExpressions.expression: unselfish adj. / unselfishness n. / selfish adj. / selfless adj.
advancedExpressions.example: His unselfishness on the court set a fine example.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He is a kind player who helps others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He is an unselfish player, always putting the team above personal glory.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 unselfish 精准替换泛泛的 kind，突出体育精神主题

classPractice.question:
It was a selfless act to give up his own chance for the team. (用 unselfish 改写)
It was an ____ act to give up his own chance for the team.
classPractice.note: unselfish = selfless，二者同义可互换，均作定语修饰 act

classPractice.question: 他在场上无私的表现赢得了队友的尊重。（用 unselfish）
classPractice.answer: His unselfish performance on the field won the respect of his teammates.
classPractice.note: unselfish 作前置定语；on the field 表地点

classPractice.question: Sharing the credit with the whole team showed his great ____ (unselfish).
classPractice.note: 介词/动词后需名词，unselfish 的名词形式为 unselfishness

translation: 【课件】欢天喜地；得意扬扬；欣喜若狂
original_sentence: More often than not, winning has the victor walking on air, lost in the glory of the moment, while the loser is left with a bitter taste and a feeling of failure.
definitionEn: to feel extremely happy and excited about something.

posExamples.example: Are you walking on air when you achieve good grades in this exam?
posExamples.translation: 当你在这次考试中取得好成绩时，你会欣喜若狂吗？

idioms.meaning: 欢天喜地，得意扬扬（课件释义：feel extreme happiness or elation）
idioms.example: Knowing that I was promoted to be manager, I felt like walking on air.

collocations.phrase: have the victor walking on air
collocations.translation: 让胜者欣喜若狂（课件原句结构）
collocations.example: Winning had the victor walking on air.
After the good news, she felt like walking on air all day.

synonyms.example: She was over the moon about winning the gold medal.
synonyms.usage: 口语习语，作表语，后常接 about sth

synonyms.example: He was on cloud nine after passing the exam.
synonyms.usage: 习语，作表语，表极度喜悦

advancedExpressions.expression: in the air 弥漫在空气中 / up in the air 悬而未决 / on air 正在播送 / walk on air 欢天喜地
advancedExpressions.example: The students' travel plans for the summer holiday are still up in the air.

advancedExpressions.expression: 课件原句 winning has the victor walking on air, lost in the glory of the moment —— lost 为过去分词/形容词作状语，描述 victor 当时的状态；while 引导对比并列句
advancedExpressions.example: The winner ran off the field, lost in the joy of victory.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: I was very happy when I won.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Winning had me walking on air, lost in the glory of the moment.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用习语 walk on air + 分词状语 lost in... 仿写课件原句，表达更生动

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】Having accepted the order, he walked ____ air.
classPractice.note: 固定习语 walk on air，介词用 on

classPractice.question: 【课件原题】She walked away and left the question hanging ____ the air.
classPractice.note: in the air 表悬而未决/弥漫，与 walk on air 区分

classPractice.question: 得知自己被晋升为经理，我高兴坏了。（用 walk on air）
classPractice.answer: Knowing that I was promoted to be manager, I felt like walking on air.
classPractice.note: 课件仿写句；felt like + doing 或 felt I was walking on air 均可

classPractice.question: 用 on / in / up 填空：Let's have a rest now. We'll be ____ air in three minutes.
classPractice.note: on air = 正在播送，与 walk on air 的 on 区分记忆

translation: 【课件】正确客观地看待某事；分清某事的轻重缓急
original_sentence: Almost nobody likes to come second, and sometimes it is difficult to keep everything in perspective.
definitionEn: to judge the importance of something correctly, so that you do not worry about it too much.

posExamples.example: You will encounter many challenges on your way to success, but they must be kept in perspective.
posExamples.translation: 在通往成功的道路上你会遇到许多挑战，但必须正确看待它们。

idioms.meaning: 正确客观地看待某事（课件：judge the importance of something correctly）
idioms.example: Remember to keep things in perspective.

idioms.meaning: 没有客观地看待某事（课件对比短语）
idioms.example: Don't keep a small setback out of perspective.

idioms.meaning: 明察事理（课件对比短语）
idioms.example: A good coach always has a sense of perspective.

collocations.translation: 正确看待一切（课件原句词块）
collocations.example: It is difficult to keep everything in perspective when you lose.
From my perspective, taking part matters more than winning.

collocations.translation: 提供更广阔的视角（课件）
collocations.example: Travelling abroad can provide a wider perspective on life.
Sport can shape our perspectives on success and failure.

synonyms.example: Losing one game puts the whole season into perspective.
synonyms.usage: 近义习语，用 put...into 而非 keep...in，同表客观看待

synonyms.synonym: see sth in its true light
synonyms.example: Once calm, she saw the defeat in its true light.
synonyms.usage: 作谓语，强调看清事情本质

advancedExpressions.expression: keep sth in perspective 正确看待 / from one's perspective 从某人角度 / provide a wider perspective 提供更广视角 / shape one's perspectives 塑造观点
advancedExpressions.example: Try to keep your defeats in perspective and learn from them.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·it 作形式主语
advancedExpressions.expression: 课件原句 it is difficult to keep everything in perspective —— it 作形式主语，真正主语是不定式 to keep...；对比 It is important to remember that...
advancedExpressions.example: It is difficult to keep everything in perspective under pressure.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: You should not worry too much about one failure.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: You should keep one failure in perspective and stay focused on the bigger goal.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用习语替换 not worry too much，表达更地道、书面

classPractice.question: 在通往成功的道路上你会遇到许多挑战，但必须正确看待它们。（用 keep...in perspective）
