posExamples.translation: 他握紧拳头，准备打架。

idioms.meaning: 握紧拳头
idioms.example: Clench your fist and then relax it.

idioms.meaning: 对某人挥拳(表示愤怒或威胁)
idioms.example: He shook his fist at the referee.

collocations.example: The boxer clenched his fists.
He raised his fists to celebrate the win.
She shook her fist at the noisy crowd.
He punched the bag hard with his fist.

synonyms.example: He hit the table with his hand.
synonyms.usage: n.，泛指手；fist 特指五指紧握的拳头

synonyms.example: He threw a powerful punch.
synonyms.usage: n./v.，指"出拳的动作或一击"；fist 是握起的手本身

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·身体部位·手部动作
advancedExpressions.expression: clench one's fist(握拳) / shake one's fist(挥拳) / raise one's fists(举拳) / bump fists(碰拳)
advancedExpressions.example: The two players bumped fists after the goal.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He closed his hand tightly and got angry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He clenched his fist in anger.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 clench one's fist 精准表达"愤怒地握紧拳头"，动作与情绪一体

classPractice.question: 拳击手举起双拳保护自己的脸。
classPractice.answer: The boxer raised his fists to protect his face.
classPractice.note: fist 可数名词，两只手用复数 fists；不定式表目的

classPractice.question: He clenched his _______ (fist) and got ready to fight.
classPractice.note: 两只手握拳，用复数 fists(也可只握一只手用 fist，此处双拳)

classPractice.question: 选词填空(fist / waist): She shook her _______ at the driver who had cut in front of her.
classPractice.note: shake one's fist at sb 对某人挥拳；waist 意为腰不合语境

translation: 腰；腰部；(衣服的)腰身
original_sentence: The wrestler grabbed his opponent around the waist and lifted him off the ground.
definitionEn: the part of the body above the hips and below the ribs, which is usually narrower than the parts above and below it.

uncommonMeanings.example: The water came up to his waist.
These trousers are too tight around the waist.

posExamples.example: He put his arm around her waist.
posExamples.translation: 他用胳膊搂住她的腰。

posExamples.example: The long jumper had a slim waist and strong legs.
posExamples.translation: 那名跳远运动员腰身纤细、双腿有力。

collocations.example: He tied a belt around his waist.
The flood water was up to their waists.
The dancer has a very slim waist.

collocations.phrase: put one's arm around sb's waist
collocations.example: He gently put his arm around her waist.

synonyms.example: The water reached his middle.
synonyms.usage: n.，非正式，指身体中段；waist 特指肋骨下、髋部上的"腰部"

advancedExpressions.expression: waist n. 腰(名词) ↔ waste n./v. 浪费(同音异形词 /weɪst/)
advancedExpressions.example: Don't waste (浪费) time worrying about your waist (腰围).

advancedExpressions.expression: waist(腰) / chest(胸) / hip(髋) / back(背) / shoulder(肩)
advancedExpressions.example: The belt fits tightly around his waist.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The water was as high as the middle of his body.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The water came up to his waist.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 up to one's waist 精准表达"齐腰深"，比 as high as the middle 简洁

classPractice.question: 摔跤手抱住对手的腰，把他举离了地面。
classPractice.answer: The wrestler grabbed his opponent around the waist and lifted him off the ground.
classPractice.note: grab sb around the waist 抱住某人的腰；around the waist 固定搭配

classPractice.question: 选词填空(waist / waste): It would be a _______ of time to argue with him.
classPractice.note: waste 与 waist 同音；此处指"浪费时间"，用 waste；a waste of time

classPractice.question: The flood water rose up to their _______ (waist).
classPractice.note: their 指多人，各自的腰用复数 waists；up to one's waist 齐腰深

translation: 残忍的，残酷的；【课件】刻薄的，令人痛苦的
original_sentence: It would be cruel and unfair to make such a remark about a player who has tried his best.
definitionEn: willing to cause pain or suffering to others, or feeling no concern about it; causing pain or distress.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （局面、事实）令人痛苦的，无情的
uncommonMeanings.example: It was a cruel blow to lose the final in the last minute.

posExamples.example: It would be rude and cruel to laugh at a beaten opponent.
posExamples.translation: 嘲笑输掉比赛的对手既无礼又残忍。

collocations.translation: 刻薄的评论（【课件】make an unfair and cruel remark 发表有失公允的刻薄评论）
collocations.example: He hurt her deeply with one cruel remark.
Some fans can be cruel to players who make a mistake.
It is cruel and unfair to blame the goalkeeper for the whole loss.

synonyms.example: The coach made a harsh comment after the defeat.
synonyms.usage: 作定语或表语；harsh criticism/words 侧重言辞严厉苛刻。

synonyms.example: The champion showed merciless pressure on his rival.
synonyms.usage: 作定语；强调毫无怜悯之心，语气比 cruel 更重。

advancedExpressions.expression: cruel(adj.) → cruelty(n.) 残忍；虐待
advancedExpressions.example: Cruelty to animals is against the law.

advancedExpressions.expression: cruel / harsh / merciless / heartless / unkind
advancedExpressions.example: It was heartless of them to mock the losing team.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The remark was not kind and not fair.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The remark was both cruel and unfair, leaving the young athlete in tears.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 cruel and unfair 并列形容词升级，再加分词状语补充结果。

classPractice.question: 对失败的对手说出如此刻薄的话，既残忍又不公平。（cruel）
classPractice.answer: It is both cruel and unfair to make such a remark to a defeated opponent.
classPractice.note: cruel and unfair 常并列使用；make a remark to sb 对某人发表评论。

classPractice.question: It was ____ (cruel) of the crowd to boo the injured player as he left the field.
classPractice.note: It is/was + adj. + of sb to do 结构，形容人的品性用 cruel。

classPractice.question: Cruelty to animals / Cruel to animals ____ is forbidden by law.（选填正确的名词短语）
classPractice.note: 作主语需用名词 cruelty；cruel 是形容词不能作主语。

translation: 【课件】n. 谈论，言论，评论；v. 说起，谈论，评论
original_sentence: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
definitionEn: n. something that you say, giving your opinion about something or stating a fact; v. to say something as a comment.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】说起，谈论，评论（remark + that 从句 / remark on/upon sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Critics remarked that the play was not original.

posExamples.example: What exactly did you mean by that last remark?
posExamples.translation: 你最后那句话究竟是什么意思？

posExamples.example: "It's much colder than yesterday," he remarked casually.
posExamples.translation: "今天比昨天冷多了。"他漫不经心地说。

wordForms.meaning: 非凡的；奇异的；显著的；引人注目的

collocations.translation: 对某事发表评论（【课件】make a rude/cruel remark about）
collocations.example: He made a number of rude remarks about the food.
The judges remarked on the high standard of entries for the competition.
Critics remarked that the play was not original.

collocations.translation: 有失公允的刻薄评论（【课件】课件原短语）
collocations.example: It would be unkind to make such an unfair and cruel remark about a beginner.
Her remarks on the employment question led to a heated discussion.

synonyms.example: He made no comment on the referee's decision.
synonyms.usage: n. make a comment on/about sth；v. comment on sth，与 remark 用法几乎相同。

synonyms.example: She made a few sharp observations about the match.
synonyms.usage: n. 较正式，make an observation about/on sth，指基于观察得出的评论。

synonyms.example: The coach issued a short statement after the game.
synonyms.usage: n. 指正式的、公开的表态，比 remark 更书面正式。

advancedExpressions.expression: remark(n./v.) → remarkable(adj. 非凡的) → remarkably(adv. 惊人地)
advancedExpressions.example: It was a remarkable achievement, and she was remarkably calm about it.

advancedExpressions.expression: make a remark about sth / remark on(upon) sth / remark that + 从句
advancedExpressions.example: On several occasions the teacher remarked on the boy's improvement.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·remark how + 形容词/副词
advancedExpressions.expression: remark how + adj./adv. + 主语 + 谓语（感叹式宾语从句）
advancedExpressions.example: As we flew home over Britain, both of us remarked how green everything looked.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The teacher said the boy had made progress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On several occasions the teacher remarked on the boy's improvement.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 remark on sth 替代 say，更书面；on several occasions 提升状语。

classPractice.question: Her remarks ____ the employment question led to a heated discussion.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用】remark(s) on/about sth 就某事的评论。

classPractice.question: A remark ____ Analects of Confucius can best express my feeling right now.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用】表示"出自/引自《论语》"，用 from 或 by。

classPractice.question: Dr Johnson once ____ (remark) that "when a man is tired of London, he is tired of life."
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用】once 表过去，且作动词，用过去式 remarked；remark that 从句。

classPractice.question: 有几次老师说起过那个男孩的进步。On several occasions the teacher ____ ____ ____ ____ improvement.（每空一词）
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用】remark on sth 谈论某事。

classPractice.question: 评论她的发型是很不礼貌的。（每空一词提示：remark on）
classPractice.answer: It would be rude to remark on / upon her hairstyle.
classPractice.note: 【课件语境应用】remark on/upon sth。

translation: 毛巾，手巾
original_sentence: In boxing, a trainer would throw a towel into the ring to stop the fight, so "throw in the towel" came to mean giving up.
definitionEn: a piece of cloth or paper used for drying something wet, especially your body or your hands.

posExamples.example: After the match, the swimmer wrapped a warm towel around her shoulders.
posExamples.translation: 比赛后，那名游泳运动员用一条温暖的毛巾裹住肩膀。

idioms.meaning: 认输，放弃（源自拳击：教练把毛巾扔进拳击台以停止比赛）
idioms.example: After losing three sets, he finally threw in the towel.

collocations.example: She spread a beach towel on the sand and lay down.
He dried his hands with a paper towel.
A true athlete never throws in the towel just because of one defeat.

synonyms.example: Wipe the equipment with a clean cloth.
synonyms.usage: n. 泛指一块布；towel 特指擦拭身体或手的毛巾。

advancedExpressions.expression: throw in the towel（认输）↔ never give up / hold on / hang in there
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of throwing in the towel, the team hung in there and won.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: He decided to give up the game.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With no strength left, he had no choice but to throw in the towel.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用体育习语 throw in the towel 替代 give up，更地道生动。

classPractice.question: After failing again and again, some people simply throw in the ____.（认输）
classPractice.note: throw in the towel 认输，固定习语。

classPractice.question: 尽管落后很多，这支球队也从不轻言放弃。（throw in the towel）
classPractice.answer: Even though they were far behind, the team never threw in the towel.
classPractice.note: throw in the towel = 认输、放弃。

classPractice.question: He wrapped a warm ____ (towel / cloth) around the shivering child after the race.
classPractice.note: 擦拭或包裹身体用 towel（毛巾），cloth 泛指布。

translation: 【课件】按字面意义地，逐字地；（用于加强语气）简直，确实
original_sentence: When I told you "Let's roll", you shouldn't take it literally.
definitionEn: in a literal way; used to emphasize the truth of what you are saying, especially when it seems surprising.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（用于加强语气，并非字面意思）简直，确实
uncommonMeanings.example: I literally jumped out of my skin.

posExamples.example: You shouldn't take the idiom literally; it doesn't mean what the words say.
posExamples.translation: 你不该从字面上去理解这个习语，它并不是字面上的意思。

collocations.translation: 从字面上理解某事（【课件】take it literally）
collocations.example: Don't take his joke literally—he was only teasing.
"Break a leg" cannot be understood by its literal translation.
I was literally shaking with excitement.

synonyms.example: He was actually the fastest runner in the whole school.
synonyms.usage: adv. 作状语，强调事实；literally 强调"字面上/毫不夸张地"。

synonyms.example: She repeated the coach's instructions word for word.
synonyms.usage: 副词短语，多作状语，等于 literally 的"逐字"义。

advancedExpressions.expression: literal(字面的) / literally(字面地) / literary(文学的) / literacy(读写能力)
advancedExpressions.example: The literal meaning differs from the literary use of the phrase.

advancedExpressions.expression: literal 字面的（the literal meaning）≠ literary 文学的（literary works）
advancedExpressions.example: This is the literal, not the literary, sense of the word.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Don't understand the idiom by its exact words.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Being figurative, the idiom should not be taken literally.
sentenceUpgrade.note: take sth literally 是地道搭配，比 understand by exact words 更简洁。

classPractice.question: "Let's roll" is an idiom, so you shouldn't take it ____ (literal).
classPractice.note: 【课件】修饰动词 take，用副词 literally。

classPractice.question: This is a ____ (literal / literary) translation, so it sounds a little strange in Chinese.
classPractice.note: 直译用 literal（字面的），literary 意为"文学的"。

classPractice.question: 听到那个消息，我简直吓了一大跳。（literally）
classPractice.answer: When I heard the news, I literally jumped out of my skin.
classPractice.note: 【课件】literally 加强语气；jump out of one's skin 吓一大跳。

translation: 大致不差，八九不离十（数字、估计等接近正确）
original_sentence: Your guess of the cost is in the ballpark, though the exact figure is a little higher.
definitionEn: within a reasonable or acceptable range; close to the correct amount, though not exact.

posExamples.example: "Would 500 dollars cover it?" "Yes, that's in the ballpark."
posExamples.translation: "500 美元够吗？""够，大致差不多。"

idioms.meaning: （估计、数字）大致接近正确，八九不离十
idioms.example: The estimate you gave is in the ballpark.

collocations.example: His prediction of the score turned out to be in the ballpark.

collocations.translation: 大方向正确，八九不离十
collocations.example: Your figures aren't exact, but they're in the right ballpark.

synonyms.example: Her guess was close to the mark.
synonyms.usage: 习语，作表语；与 in the ballpark 意思相近，指估计接近正确。

advancedExpressions.expression: in the ballpark（大致不差）/ a ballpark estimate/figure（大致的估计/数字）
advancedExpressions.example: Give me a ballpark figure first, and we'll check whether it's in the ballpark.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Your guess is nearly right.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Your guess is in the ballpark, though not exact.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用棒球习语 in the ballpark 替代 nearly right，更地道。

classPractice.question: "Is 30 minutes enough?" "Yes, that's about right—it's in the ____."（大致不差）
classPractice.note: in the ballpark 大致接近正确，源自棒球。

classPractice.question: 虽然不是确切数字，但你的估计大致不差。（in the ballpark）
classPractice.answer: Although it isn't the exact figure, your estimate is in the ballpark.
classPractice.note: in the ballpark 八九不离十。

classPractice.question: 改写下句，意思不变：Your prediction of the final score was almost right. → Your prediction of the final score was in the ____.
classPractice.note: in the ballpark = almost right / close to correct 大致接近正确。

translation: 大致的估计，粗略的估算
original_sentence: Can you give me a ballpark estimate of how much the new stadium will cost?
definitionEn: a rough estimate; an approximate figure that is not exact but close enough to be useful.

posExamples.example: As a ballpark estimate, the trip will take about three hours.
posExamples.translation: 粗略估计，这趟行程大约需要三个小时。

idioms.meaning: 大致的估计/数字（不精确但足够参考）
idioms.example: Just give me a ballpark figure for now.

collocations.example: The builder gave us a ballpark estimate before signing the contract.
A ballpark figure of one million people attended the event.

synonyms.example: Can you give me a rough estimate of the repair cost?
synonyms.usage: 名词短语；与 a ballpark estimate 完全同义，rough 更常见于书面。

advancedExpressions.expression: a ballpark estimate/figure（大致的估计）↔ be in the ballpark（大致不差）
advancedExpressions.example: The ballpark estimate he gave was luckily in the ballpark.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: Give me a rough number of the cost.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Could you give me a ballpark estimate of the cost?
sentenceUpgrade.note: a ballpark estimate 比 rough number 更地道，尤见于口语商务语境。

classPractice.question: I don't need the exact price—just give me a ____ estimate.（大致的）
classPractice.note: a ballpark estimate/figure 大致的估计。

classPractice.question: 你能给我一个新体育馆造价的大致估计吗？（a ballpark estimate）
classPractice.answer: Can you give me a ballpark estimate of the cost of the new stadium?
classPractice.note: a ballpark estimate of sth 对某物的粗略估计。

classPractice.question: 改写下句，意思不变：Just give me a rough figure of the total cost. → Just give me a ballpark ____ of the total cost.
classPractice.note: a ballpark figure = a rough figure 一个大概的数字，与 a ballpark estimate 同义。

translation: 给某人出乎意料的难题，让某人措手不及
original_sentence: Life sometimes throws you a curveball when you least expect it.
definitionEn: to surprise someone with something unexpected and difficult to deal with (from baseball, where a curveball is hard to hit).

posExamples.example: The interviewer threw me a curveball with his last question.
posExamples.translation: 面试官最后一个问题把我问得措手不及。

idioms.meaning: 给某人意想不到的难题；让某人措手不及
idioms.example: The sudden rule change threw the whole team a curveball.

collocations.translation: 给某人出难题，让某人措手不及
collocations.example: Just when things were going well, fate threw him a curveball.
A good leader knows how to handle a curveball calmly.

synonyms.example: The question caught her completely off guard.
synonyms.usage: 习语，catch sb off guard；强调出其不意，与 throw sb a curveball 语义相近。

advancedExpressions.expression: throw sb a curveball（给某人出难题）↔ handle it well / rise to the challenge
advancedExpressions.example: Life threw him a curveball, but he rose to the challenge.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The exam had a very surprising question.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The exam threw us a curveball with an unexpected question at the end.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 throw sb a curveball 替代 have a surprising question，更形象生动。

classPractice.question: The last question in the interview really threw me a ____.（意想不到的难题）
classPractice.note: throw sb a curveball 让某人措手不及，源自棒球的"曲线球"。

classPractice.question: 生活有时会在你毫无防备时给你出难题。（throw sb a curveball）
classPractice.answer: Life sometimes throws you a curveball when you least expect it.
classPractice.note: throw sb a curveball 给某人出乎意料的难题。

classPractice.question: The interviewer ____ (throw) me a curveball with his very last question, and I froze for a moment.
classPractice.note: and 后的 froze 为过去时，前一分句也用过去式 threw；throw sb a curveball 让某人措手不及。

word: three strikes and you are out
translation: 事不过三，三次失败就出局（机会用尽即遭淘汰）
original_sentence: As it suggests, in baseball this means that a batter is out if he or she makes three unsuccessful attempts to hit the ball.
definitionEn: used to say that after three failures or mistakes, someone loses their chance or is not allowed to continue (from baseball).

posExamples.example: In this company it's three strikes and you're out—repeated mistakes cost you the job.
posExamples.translation: 在这家公司里事不过三，屡次犯错就得走人。

idioms.idiom: three strikes and you are out
idioms.meaning: 事不过三；三次失败便被淘汰
idioms.example: The teacher's rule was simple: three strikes and you're out.

collocations.translation: 三次尝试失败（【课件】原文 batter is out if he makes three unsuccessful attempts）
collocations.example: In baseball, a batter is out after three unsuccessful attempts.
The club follows a strict three-strikes rule for late members.

synonyms.example: After this, there are no more second chances.
synonyms.usage: 口语表达；强调机会用尽，与 three strikes and you're out 同一情境。

advancedExpressions.expression: three strikes and you're out（事不过三）↔ give sb a second/last chance
advancedExpressions.example: We gave him a last chance, but three strikes and you're out.

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·as 引导非限制性定语从句
advancedExpressions.expression: as 替代整个句子，引导非限制性定语从句：As it suggests / As you know
advancedExpressions.example: As it suggests, three strikes means the batter is out.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: If you fail three times, you lose your chance.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rule here is straightforward: three strikes and you're out.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用棒球习语总结"事不过三"的规则，比直白陈述更凝练地道。

classPractice.question: 在我们的比赛中，规则很简单：事不过三，三次失败就出局。（three strikes and you're out）
classPractice.answer: In our game the rule is simple: three strikes and you're out.
classPractice.note: 习语，表"机会用尽即被淘汰"。

classPractice.question: ____ it suggests, in baseball a batter is out after three unsuccessful attempts.
classPractice.note: 【课件】as 引导非限制性定语从句，替代整句，意为"正如"。

classPractice.question: Make one more mistake and you'll be off the team—remember, three strikes and you're ____.
classPractice.note: three strikes and you're out 事不过三，三次失败便出局。

translation: （言行）不光明正大的，卑鄙的，不公正的（源自拳击禁击腰带以下）
original_sentence: Making fun of his family was really hitting below the belt.
definitionEn: unfair or cruel; used about a remark or action that is dishonourable (from boxing, where hitting below the belt is against the rules).

posExamples.example: That comment about her weight was really below the belt.
posExamples.translation: 那句关于她体重的话实在太卑鄙了。

idioms.idiom: below the belt / hit below the belt
idioms.meaning: （言行）不公正、卑鄙、下流
idioms.example: Bringing up his past mistakes was hitting below the belt.

collocations.translation: 使用卑鄙手段，暗箭伤人
collocations.example: In the debate, he hit his opponent below the belt.
That was a remark below the belt, and everyone felt it was unfair.

synonyms.example: It was an unfair attack on his character.
synonyms.usage: adj. 作定语或表语；below the belt 更口语、更强调"卑鄙暗算"。

advancedExpressions.expression: below the belt / hit below the belt（卑鄙不公）↔ play fair / fair play
advancedExpressions.example: A true sportsman plays fair and never hits below the belt.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: His comment was very unfair and mean.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His comment was really below the belt.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用拳击习语 below the belt 替代 unfair and mean，更形象。

classPractice.question: Attacking his disabled brother was really hitting below the ____.（卑鄙的）
classPractice.note: below the belt / hit below the belt 卑鄙不公，源自拳击禁击腰带以下。

classPractice.question: 拿他的家人开玩笑实在太卑鄙了。（below the belt）
classPractice.answer: Making fun of his family was really below the belt.
classPractice.note: below the belt 指言行卑鄙、不光明正大。

classPractice.question: 改写下句，意思不变：That comment about her illness was really unfair and mean. → That comment about her illness was really below the ____.
classPractice.note: below the belt = unfair and mean（言行卑鄙不公），源自拳击禁击腰带以下。

translation: 认输，放弃（源自拳击：教练把毛巾扔进拳击台以停止比赛）
original_sentence: Even when he was far behind, the boxer refused to throw in the towel.
definitionEn: to admit that you have been defeated and stop trying (from boxing, where a trainer throws a towel into the ring to end the fight).

posExamples.example: After months of struggling with the business, they finally threw in the towel.
posExamples.translation: 苦苦经营几个月后，他们最终认输放弃了。

idioms.meaning: 认输，放弃
idioms.example: Don't throw in the towel just because of one setback.

collocations.example: A champion never throws in the towel after a single defeat.

collocations.phrase: refuse to throw in the towel
collocations.example: The team refused to throw in the towel and fought to the end.

synonyms.example: He never gives up, no matter how hard it gets.
synonyms.usage: 短语动词，give up (doing) sth；throw in the towel 更形象，特指"认输"。

synonyms.example: She was too proud to admit defeat.
synonyms.usage: 动词短语；与 throw in the towel 同义，语气更正式直接。

advancedExpressions.expression: throw in the towel（认输）↔ hang in there / hold on / never give up
advancedExpressions.example: Instead of throwing in the towel, hang in there and keep fighting.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The player did not want to give up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Trailing badly, the player still refused to throw in the towel.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用拳击习语 throw in the towel 替代 give up，配 trailing badly 分词状语。

classPractice.question: No matter how tough things get, a true fighter never throws in the ____.（认输）
classPractice.note: throw in the towel 认输、放弃，源自拳击扔毛巾停赛。

classPractice.question: 尽管远远落后，那名拳击手仍拒绝认输。（throw in the towel）
classPractice.answer: Even when he was far behind, the boxer refused to throw in the towel.
classPractice.note: throw in the towel = admit defeat / give up。

classPractice.question: 改写：After many failures, they finally gave up. → After many failures, they finally ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: give up = throw in the towel，注意过去式 threw。

translation: 铁；熨斗；n. (体育) 高尔夫铁头球杆；vt. 熨烫；adj. 铁的，坚强的
original_sentence: Years of hard training gave the champion an iron will that no defeat could break.
definitionEn: n. a hard, strong, grey metal used to make steel and found in small amounts in blood and food; also a tool for pressing clothes.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 钢铁般的，坚强的（意志、纪律）
uncommonMeanings.example: She trained with iron discipline every single day.
He ironed his team shirt before the match.
The golfer chose a seven iron for the shot.

posExamples.example: The gate was made of solid iron.
posExamples.translation: 这扇大门是用坚实的铁制成的。

posExamples.example: An athlete needs an iron will to keep going through pain.
posExamples.translation: 运动员需要钢铁般的意志才能忍着伤痛坚持下去。

wordForms.meaning: 熨烫（的衣物）；待熨的衣物

idioms.meaning: 有钢铁般的意志
idioms.example: Only those with an iron will can win an Olympic gold.

idioms.idiom: strike while the iron is hot
idioms.meaning: 趁热打铁，抓住时机
idioms.example: You have the momentum now—strike while the iron is hot.

collocations.example: The runner finished the marathon through sheer iron will.
The coach ran the team with iron discipline.
The old bridge is made of iron.
She ironed her shirt neatly before the ceremony.

synonyms.example: He steeled himself for the tough final.
synonyms.usage: n. 钢（合金）；v. steel oneself for/against 使自己坚强。与 iron 均可喻"坚强"。

advancedExpressions.expression: an iron will / iron discipline / strike while the iron is hot / have too many irons in the fire
advancedExpressions.example: With an iron will, she seized the chance and struck while the iron was hot.

advancedExpressions.expression: iron 由"铁"(n.)引申为"熨斗"(n.)、"熨烫"(vt.)、"钢铁般的"(adj.)
advancedExpressions.example: He needs to iron his shirt, but his iron is broken.

sentenceUpgrade.simple: The champion was very determined and strong-willed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The champion had an iron will that no defeat could break.
sentenceUpgrade.note: 用 iron will 名词短语替代 determined，形象且高级。

classPractice.question: Years of training gave her an ____ will, so she never gave up.（坚强的）
classPractice.note: iron will 钢铁般的意志，iron 作定语意为"坚强的"。

classPractice.question: 你现在势头正好，应该趁热打铁。（strike while the iron is hot）
classPractice.answer: You have the momentum now, so you should strike while the iron is hot.
classPractice.note: strike while the iron is hot 趁热打铁，固定习语。

classPractice.question: The huge medal was made of ____ (iron / irony), heavy and cold to the touch.
classPractice.note: 金属"铁"用 iron；irony 意为"讽刺"，词义无关。
